set.body:
Owner directive (2026-09-01, "go ahead" after the first court landed): realize the admission ledger's nominated FFmpeg 9.0.1 "Lei" recipe locally and re-record the court's envelopes under it, closing the largest honesty gap in ledger §6.2 (the first recordings used a GPL-enabled Homebrew 7.1.1 build).

What lands
- Acquisition: ffmpeg-9.0.1.tar.xz (sha256 cf38e0e2…) and its .asc from ffmpeg.org; release key fetched over HTTPS from ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-devel.asc into a temporary keyring; primary fingerprint FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8 equals the ledger §4 record; gpg reports a good signature. Receipt in tmp/ffmpeg-9.0.1/RECEIPT.txt (untracked; digests copied into the ledger).
- Build: media/tools/build_ffmpeg_9.0.1.sh. LGPL-only, everything disabled except: protocol file; demuxer mov; decoders rawvideo, h264; parser h264; encoder and muxer rawvideo; swscale and filters scale/format/null; ffprobe and ffmpeg programs; static linking. Dynamic dependencies: libSystem, CoreFoundation, CoreVideo, CoreMedia only. ffprobe sha256 13d17dfd…, ffmpeg sha256 85c119a5… (two builds were made; the first, without --disable-videotoolbox/--disable-audiotoolbox, is superseded; bytes differ, so no reproducibility claim).
- Deviations from the §4 candidate configure line, each forced by the F0/F1 manifests and recorded in ledger §6.2: ffmpeg program enabled; static instead of shared; avfilter and swscale enabled; component selection as above.
- Envelopes re-recorded under 9.0.1: F0/F1 ffprobe stdout (F0 packet table identical to the 7.1.1 record; F1 picture table identical, last audio packet duration 1024 instead of 1008), frames envelopes (decoded bytes byte-identical to the 7.1.1 decodes: bb13ca6a…, e1fcc243…). Detector outcomes unchanged.
- Courts: 40/40 under the PATH Homebrew tools and 40/40 under the realized binaries (STORYMODEL4S_FFPROBE/FFMPEG); the F1 live court now compares the picture packet table under any tool and the full table plus identity only under the recorded binary.
- Ledger: §2 registry and §4 leaf rows for decode.ffmpeg move to Realized(digest) / LocalRealized; §6.2 gains the realized row and the deviation record.

Not established
- Reproducibility of the build (two builds differ in bytes; no second clean build compared); no SBOM, no OCI image, no corresponding-source bundle; patent posture and deployment jurisdiction HoldUnknown. The realized binaries live in the worktree's ignored tmp/ and are not committed; a machine without them runs the courts under whatever ffprobe/ffmpeg it has and compares picture tables.
set.title: First acquisition court: realize the nominated FFmpeg 9.0.1 LGPL-only recipe and re-record envelopes under it
